versions.content: [SWS_EM_02109] Process pre-mapping Upstream requirements: RS_EM_00005 ⌈Execution Management shall pre-map a Process if Process.preMapping is set to true.⌋ Fully pre-mapping a Modelled Process ensures that code and data execution is not going to be delayed at its first execution by demand-loading. This approach not only supports predictable timing during system startup and first execution phases, but also helps with safety where code handling error cases can be preloaded and made guar- anteed to be available. In addition, pre-mapping avoids late issues where filesystem may be corrupted and part of the Modelled Process may not be loadable anymore.
